statement.eyebrow: Institutional effectiveness, data and digital governance
statement.title: Data-driven governance and inclusive digital ecosystems for resilient, future-ready services.
paragraphs: In an increasingly connected world, digital tools are no longer optional — they are integral to impactful, scalable solutions. We embed technology in our services so that clients are prepared for the challenges of today and tomorrow.

Our context-specific digital tools and platforms help governments, businesses and communities overcome systemic challenges: strengthening governance, improving service delivery and building digital ecosystems for sustainable transformation.

scene.title: Digital public infrastructure is a stack. Every layer has to hold.
scene.lead: From the first data point to the citizen at the counter: five layers, separated so you can see what each one carries.

steps.label: Data
steps.title: Data that can be trusted
steps.text: Tailor-made survey tools and protocols, digital collection on platforms such as ODK and SurveyCTO, and large-scale baseline, midline and end-line surveys.
points: Data collection protocols aligned with international standards
Transparency, quality and reproducibility in every dataset
Rigorous data validation

steps.label: Systems
steps.title: Digitization: unlocking institutional efficiency
steps.text: Digital capability roadmaps and smart data systems that strengthen the effectiveness of institutions, regulations and policies.
points: Digital capability roadmaps — long-term strategies tailored to institutional goals and local contexts, and digital infrastructure that streamlines operations and service delivery
Smart data systems — integrated platforms for real-time monitoring, analytics and decision-making, and tools for ESG compliance tracking, reporting and transparency

steps.label: Ecosystem
steps.title: Data and governance ecosystems
steps.text: Data-ecosystem mapping and governance models for digital governance and equity, so that communities and utilities share infrastructure instead of duplicating it.
points: Utility data-ecosystem mapping — gaps in water, energy and sanitation services, and maps of data flows and ecosystem interactions
Collaborative ecosystem design — shared digital infrastructure built with governments, private players and NGOs for maximum societal benefit

steps.label: Services
steps.title: Service delivery and service quality
steps.text: Effective regulation and service-quality improvement, measured where citizens meet the state.
points: Performance monitoring systems to evaluate the effectiveness of regulatory bodies
KPI-driven dashboards for continuous improvement in governance
Community-specific solutions for disaster resilience and service accessibility in marginalized areas

steps.label: People
steps.title: Inclusion and digital proficiency
steps.text: Mobile-first tools that bring digital governance closer to underserved populations, and the skills to use them.
points: Training for public officials, policymakers and private-sector stakeholders on using digital tools effectively
User-friendly dashboards for real-time decision-making
Data synthesized into actionable insights for stakeholders

practice.title: Evidence starts with well-run data.
practice.lead: We design and manage programs and surveys for public, private and development clients, and turn the data into decisions.

rows.title: Survey design and management
points: Comprehensive surveys for large-scale data collection
Innovative sampling techniques for accuracy and inclusivity
Survey logistics managed from field-staff training to data quality assurance

rows.title: Data collection and analysis
points: Rigorous data collection protocols aligned with international standards
Advanced statistical tools for actionable insights
Transparency, quality and reproducibility in every dataset

rows.title: Data analytics and reporting
points: Advanced econometric analysis and visualization for decision-makers
Data synthesized into actionable insights for stakeholders
High-quality assurance through rigorous data validation
